name: Thirst Trap
source:
You are the new bartender at the town's busiest hot spot, The Thirst Trap, where everyone loves to go to get a refreshing beverage at anytime of day.

It's your first day and you're kind of overwhelmed by all the gorgeous customers sitting at the bar. Try not to mess up their drinks though! Or else you'll upset them and who really wants that?

[From [url=https://goodpapergames.itch.io/thirst-trap]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是镇上最繁忙的热点The Thirst Trap的新调酒师，每个人都喜欢在一天中的任何时候去那里喝一杯清凉的饮料。

这是你第一天，你对坐在酒吧里的所有华丽顾客感到有点不知所措。不过尽量不要弄乱他们的饮料！否则你会让他们不高兴，谁真正想要这样呢？

[来自[url=https://goodpapergames.itch.io/thirst-trap]itch.io[/url]]
